title: BugleRock Mutual NDA Fields
description: Fillable slots for the BugleRock mutual NDA template. Every key MUST be present; values are validated for type and format. Any extra field not listed here is rejected.

counterparty_name.description: Full legal name of the counterparty (individual or entity).

signatory_name.description: Name of the BugleRock signatory for THIS document. Optional — omit to leave a blank signature rule for wet/e-signature. Free text: not restricted to the rules.yaml signatories list, which is advisory only.

signatory_title.description: Title of the BugleRock signatory for THIS document (e.g. 'Director'). Optional — omit to leave a blank title rule.
